Statewide.Discontinuation Information: Per ACLU's reporting, the Eckerd Kids predictive modeling software was discontinued due to ``difficulties in implementation and questions results''.

Overall expenditure.Column: The philanthropic grants and contracts supporting the development, implementation, and maintenance of the RSM have been paid directly to the Department's research and implementation partners. The Department has therefore not expended County funds for these purposes and maintains no line-item budgets or purchase orders responsive to this request.
